key.description: The key used to route to this shard

partition_index.description: Which partition this shard belongs to

mechanism: The fundamental primitive of distribution. It deterministically partitions a {{resource}}, {{state}}, or {{vector}} into disjoint subsets (Shards) based on a Key (e.g., ID, Hash, Time). Unlike {{decompose}}, which splits complexity, Shard splits volume and load.
invariants: Determinism: Key K always routes to Shard S.

parameters.name: key_function
parameters.description: Partitioning strategy for distributing data across shards

parameters.name: partitions
parameters.description: Number of partitions to divide state into

failure_modes: Hot shard: skewed keys concentrate load on one partition — a consequence of Determinism.
Rebinding on resize: changing the partition count invalidates every routing decision taken under the old count.
Cross-shard operation: spanning shards requires coordination, because Disjointness guarantees no shard holds another's data.
